summary.name: Movie Catcher
summary.one_liner: A Chinese-language desktop app that searches movie and US TV show download resources by title, then offers Baidu Netdisk offline downloads and online playback.
use_cases: Finding download sources for a movie by title
Streaming movies from a netdisk without a desktop client
Getting real offline download addresses from Baidu Netdisk
Searching for US TV shows from Chinese resource sites
summary.what_it_does: The app integrates several resource websites and netdisk offline features. Users search for movies or US TV shows by title to find download resources. It can play content online through a netdisk or retrieve the real download address for netdisk offline downloading, so no client is needed. The initial version supports search, offline download, and online playback, with more features and sources planned. The source code is on GitHub and a .spec file is provided for building with PyInstaller.
notable: Integrates resource sites and Baidu Netdisk offline download with online playback
Open source with code on GitHub and a PyInstaller .spec file
Built in Python 2.7.10 using Pillow and selenium
caveats: Windows version requires Windows 7 SP1 or later and does not support 32-bit systems
Requires Chrome v59 to v61 as an additional program
Mac version cannot easily input Chinese text, per the author's note
